title: The run-4 search-submit repair
goal: Fix the run-4 search stall (owner-approved recommendation): deterministic post-type submit for plan-enterText browser-chrome types (gate-null/ungated only), plan-enterText authority for native TYPE, prompt v11 (type-then-submit, full query, results-shaped done conditions), the terminal event in the evidence dir, and a notification Stop task action. NO device or emulator test until the owner explicitly says.
stoppingCondition: The search submit fires deterministically in JVM scripted tests without bypassing the gate or a credential secret; the typed and gate-classified text is the plan enterText; v11 pins; every VisionLoop return writes a terminal evidence line; the notification Stop task cancels via the existing flag; gates green + APK < 40MB; docs/status/compliance updated; no installs/device runs.

workItems.WI1_DETERMINISTIC_POST_TYPE_SUBMIT: VisionLoop.attemptStep TYPE branch: after a successful TYPE (native or tap-converted) with secretSwap == null, the plan enterText non-blank and the typed text equal to it, and a typed field whose a11y node is browserChrome (typeField?.browserChrome == true, or the raw arm's VisionMath.editableNodeAt(obs.nodes, actX, actY)?.browserChrome == true), the loop gate-classifies a SUBMIT with the SAME gateCandidate(..., ActionKind.SUBMIT) + GateAction(candidate, SUBMIT, typedText) + PageContext(obs.url, FieldDescriptor.fromNodes(obs.nodes)) and calls executor.submit() IMMEDIATELY after enterText in the same step ONLY when the classifier is null or gatePresenter == null. A classified submit is left to the normal gated flow; a failed submit never throws; executed stays the type's boolean. Evidence `search submit: <ok|failed> node=<id>`; step markers `(search submitted)` / `(search submit failed)`.
workItems.WI2_PLAN_TEXT_AUTHORITY: VisionLoop.attemptStep: for an effective TYPE with a non-blank plan enterText (and not the already-converting tap path), effectiveText = the plan enterText, so BOTH the gate classification and the typed text use it; a divergent proposal text is overridden and the step line gains `(plan text)` only when it differed. A credential card's secretSwap still replaces the text at execution (never overridden); the marker is suppressed on the secret path because the plan text was not the typed value.
workItems.WI3_PROMPT_V11: VisionPrompts: PLAN_SYSTEM gains the TYPE-THEN-SUBMIT sequence (IME Search/Go/Done key), the COMPLETE-query enterText law (dates/location/filters) and the results-page/results-only-marker search condition; PROPOSE_SYSTEM gains submit-after-typing, never-tap-omnibox-suggestions-or-clear-X, submit-a-suggestion-showing-the-typed-query and type-exactly-the-subtask-enterText. VISION_PROMPT_VERSION vision-exp-v10 -> vision-exp-v11; VisionExperimentTest's version pin updated and a new contract test pins all new sentences.
workItems.WI4_TERMINAL_EVIDENCE: VisionLoop.run is now a public wrapper over the renamed private runLoop: every return writes ONE final evidence event `terminal=<TERMINAL> steps=<n> replans=<n>` (answer optional, whitespace-flattened, <=120 chars) and returns the same Result. VisionTerminalEvidenceTest (temp-dir VisionEvidence) asserts exactly one terminal line for GOAL_ACHIEVED and for CANCELLED.
workItems.WI4_NOTIFICATION_STOP: NavigatorService.buildNotification adds a standard 'Stop task' action ONLY when state == NOTIFICATION_WORKING (PendingIntent.getService + the new ACTION_STOP_TASK const); onStartCommand's ACTION_STOP_TASK calls taskCancelFlag.cancelActive() and appends one corner-log line 'stop requested — ending at the next step'. READY keeps exactly the 'New task' action; no other notification/UI change. NavigatorServiceNotificationTest (Robolectric) pins both.
workItems.WI5_DOCS: app/AGENTS.md vision bullet (prompt v11 + the VEXP6 WI1/WI2/WI4 laws + the new JVM gates), root AGENTS.md one compact VEXP6 clause, .state/DEBUGGING.md VEXP6 extension (silent product logcat, terminal event in the evidence, notification Stop task is the lawful stop), .state/phase-vexp6-status.json, .state/compliance-log.md entry. The run-4 report/evidence were NOT touched.

deviations: The `(plan text)` step marker is suppressed when a credential card's secretSwap replaces the text: the marker would falsely claim the plan text was typed; the plan text still governs the pre-gate classification per WI2.

On the raw grounding arm the SUBMIT classification candidate is built from the SAME gateCandidate(proposal, SUBMIT, actTarget=null, ...) as the acting step (per the phase doc), so its browserChrome flag is false; the browser-chrome condition itself is checked on the TYPED field (editableNodeAt) as specified. Consequence: a page whose form context makes SUBMIT classify (e.g. an identifier+password pair) withholds the auto-submit.
The terminal evidence answer is whitespace-flattened before the 120-char bound so the events.log line stays a single line (the phase doc says 'answer optional, bounded').
NavigatorServiceNotificationTest reaches the private buildNotification/state constants/taskCancelFlag via reflection rather than widening production visibility (no production API change).
No notification/UI surface beyond the standard 'Stop task' action; no budget, live-log UI, or legacy-loop change.
